activity_summary: After the Two Gentlemen, Bryan gave the court's Shrovetide as heard of: Whitehall since Saturday, a tilt, a tourney yesterday, and tonight a masque of Proteus and a rock of adamant. You said nobody was asked. Kemp set the scholars playing for nothing against a penny. Bryan had the warrant for December's twenty pounds drawn and moving, and my lord's word to stop cleanly on Shrove Tuesday and hand the Mayor no stick. You did not fetch the money. You left the old count where it was.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Said the masque was heard of only, forbade Sam to spend the warrant, and went home to answer the house.

entities.name: George Bryan
entities.context: Brought Whitehall, the masque, the moving warrant, and the order to stop cleanly.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Wanted to see the rock come on, and agreed not to go.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Set nothing against a penny, and refused a new tally for the morning.

entities.name: Sam Latchet
entities.context: Asked whether anyone speaks in a masque, and where a moving sum arrives.

facets.activity: Heard of the masque at Whitehall

quotes.speaker: will_kemp
quotes.text: The scholars play before the Queen for nothing, and we play before the scholars for a penny.

quotes.speaker: george_bryan
quotes.text: The warrant for December's twenty pounds is drawn and moving.

quotes.speaker: richard_burbage
quotes.text: I would like to see a rock come on.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Nobody is asked to this one. It is heard of only.
